text:
maria: dropped some QA notes from the accessibility pass on the new dark tokens. main concerns: focus rings, colorblind-safe chart palettes, and the heatmap legend (low/high stops).

devin: nice summary. noticed keyboard nav focus is almost invisible on cards when using compact mode. current focus ring is 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) which gets lost on #0c1016. needs more prominence and *not* rely on outline-offset alone.

phillip: agree. proposed: 2px solid var(--focus-accent) with a subtle inner shadow so it reads on both dark & dark-accented cards. maybe use --focus-accent: #7fd3ff for defaults.

tara: colorblind note: stacked area charts blend the blue/green series and create a muddy brown for deuteranopes. want us to test with a palette specifically for colorblind-safe combinations. suggestion: keep blue but swap green -> #f6b26b (warm peach) so overlaps remain readable. also add hatching option for print/exports?

maria: good catch. also the heatmap legend uses a continuous purple -> cyan ramp which is confusing at low values. for low/neutral, recommend introducing a desaturated mid stop so mid-values don't read as high. e.g., ramp: #081016 (min), #2b3140 (mid), #7ad0ff (max).

devin: small implementation nit: semantic tokens are fine, but the runtime token mapping currently uses names like token-bg-2, token-bg-3. can we move to semantic names: surface-muted / surface-elevated / code-surface? makes it easier for engineers to map to accessibility docs.

phillip: will also help with theming if we adopt a high-contrast variant set: --hc-surface, --hc-text, --hc-accent. then components can explicitly opt into them when the user enables high contrast in settings or via OS.

tara: UX copy nit for the high-contrast toggle: current label "High contrast" should be "High contrast mode (experimental)" — we're gating it behind some manual QA still. add help text pointing to docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/accessibility#high-contrast

maria: visual examples would help the PMs. i'll attach before/after snapshots in the figma comments and add an example of keyboard-only flow showing focus ring on table rows, chips, and chart points.

design-bot: branch created: feat/dark-hc-palette. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/console/pulls/412. includes tokens, storybook knobs, and a11y test harness.

devin: testing note: when enabling HC tokens the bar chart hover fill becomes fully opaque which blocks gridlines. need to change hover to a 0.9 alpha instead of 1.0 so grid remains visible.

phillip: i'll update storybook stories with a colorblind simulator checkbox and a high-contrast toggle so we can quickly eyeball problem areas.

tara: design ask: for copy on theme selector, prefer explicit: "Theme: System (default) / Light / Dark / High contrast" so the HC option is discoverable but last. also include a tooltip "experimental" for HC.

maria: ok i'll wire that copy and push the figma updates. please drop short reviews here — i'd like to ship the token rename + HC opt-in in the next sprint.

design-bot: deploy preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood-console/feat/dark-hc-palette (expires 48h). automated axe results: 12 warnings, 3 violations (focus contrast on compact cards, heatmap legend contrast, stacked-area overlap). Violation details posted to PR.

devin: thanks. i'll fix the focus ring and hover alpha, then post screenshots.

phillip: will push the semantic token rename RFC to the repo for alignment.

tara: 
- :eyes: on the figma images
- +1 on wording
- printing hatches as fallback

maria: thanks team! quick checklist for reviewers: keyboard nav, colorblind sim, HC toggle copy, chart alpha on hover. ship when green. :rocket:
